transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Well... I'm here because I keep hearing these voices at work. I hear them coming from the call-light speaker and the hallway vents. They keep telling me which patient records have been changed. It sounds... I mean, it's as clear as somebody standing right next to me speaking. But even when the unit is completely quiet, and nobody else hears it, I still do. So, that's what brought me in today.
How long have you been hearing these voices?
It has been going on for about two months now. I first started noticing them right around the time I was asked to help lead the new wound-care documentation rollout on the unit.
Have you noticed any other changes in your life, such as difficulty focusing, feeling less motivated to do things you used to enjoy, or having trouble expressing your thoughts clearly?

No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. I mean... I still go to work and do my usual routine, and I don't feel unmotivated or anything. And I think I'm talking just fine, my thoughts are clear. It's really just... the main thing is just hearing those voices about the patient records.
Have you noticed if your behavior or the way you carry out your daily tasks has become disorganized or difficult for others to follow?

No, I haven't noticed anything like that. I'm still doing my job exactly the same way I always have. My charting is done on time, I help my patients just like normal... nobody at work or at home has said I'm acting disorganized or doing things differently. It's really just the voices that are the problem.
Do you believe that the patient records you hear the voices talking about are actually being tampered with or changed by someone?

Yes, I do. I know the wound-care charts are showing a pattern that management doesn't want anyone to see. My supervisor keeps telling me it's just late entries or coding mistakes, but I know that's not true. I can tell they're watching what I write in the charts now, because I'm the one who caught it.
Have you noticed any change in your desire to spend time with friends or family, or have you found yourself preferring to be alone more often than you used to?

No, I wouldn't say that. I mean, I still see my family and we do our regular things. I haven't really been pulling away from anyone or wanting to be alone more than usual. I still like being around people, it's just... well, it's just stressful dealing with work right now. But my social life hasn't really changed.
Besides your concerns about the patient records and your supervisor, have you had any other unusual beliefs or ideas that others might find difficult to believe?
No, not really. It's just the charts and what's happening at work with my supervisor. I don't have any other strange ideas or anything like that. That's the only thing that's going on.
Have you experienced any periods where your mood was unusually low, or conversely, periods where you felt unusually energetic, talkative, or needed very little sleep?

Well, I haven't really been low, but... I do have these days where I feel like I'm just finally awake, you know? Like I have all this energy and I'm meant to fix everything going wrong at work. I can get a lot done. But if my husband or one of the nurses tells me to slow down or take a break, I get really irritable. I just snap at them. It feels like they're trying to block me from doing something really important.

During those times when you have high energy and feel irritable, do the voices and your concerns about the patient records happen at the same time, or do they only occur when you are feeling more like your usual self?

Well, they definitely happen at the same time. I never... I mean, I never heard those voices calling for help or saw the hidden messages in the charts before this whole period started. It all only began after I got so wound up and driven about the new rollout. You know, when I started sleeping a lot less and working nonstop, feeling so absolutely certain that I was the one who had to fix everything at the facility. That's when all the other stuff started happening, too.

Have you ever had these experiences with the voices or the beliefs about the charts during a time when you were feeling completely like your normal self, without that high energy or need for less sleep?

No, like I was just saying, it never happens when I'm just my normal self. I never heard the call-light voices or saw any of those hidden messages in the charts before this specific period. It wasn't until I got so driven and wound up about the new rollout. They really only started after I was sleeping a lot less, working nonstop, and feeling so absolutely certain that I had to be the one to fix everything at the facility. So, no, I've never had any of this happen before I got all that energy.
Looking back at that high-energy period when the voices started, how many weeks or months did that specific episode of high energy and decreased sleep last?
It's been going on for about two months now. That's when they asked me to help lead the new wound-care documentation rollout, and it's just been like this ever since.
